attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created missing system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc (member of that group), recursively chown'd the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rw, group r, others none). Verified original file contents preserved via matching sha256 checksums before and after the change, and confirmed access semantics (owner and a group member can read; an unrelated user cannot access the directory or files). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, issued a non-interactive shutdown -r now, polled until the node reconnected, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified ownership, permissions, and unchanged checksums post-restart.
